app.name: Julià Regader
app.description: Financial education and personal wealth organization.

home.heroEyebrow: Support for your financial education sessions
home.heroTitle: Understand your finances. Organize your wealth.
home.heroSubtitle: This app supports you between sessions so you can clearly see your income, expenses, assets and liabilities, and track your progress over time.
home.adminNotice: Manage your clients, sessions and business metrics from the admin panel.

legal.disclaimer: This tool is exclusively for educational and personal organization purposes. It does not constitute financial, tax or investment advice. Decisions are the sole responsibility of the user.

auth.title: Sign in to your account
auth.subtitle: No passwords: we'll send a sign-in link to your email.
auth.linkSentTo: We've sent a link to {{email}}. Open it from this same device to sign in.

pending.title: Your account is pending approval
pending.body: Thanks for signing up. Julià will review your request and grant access shortly. We'll email you once your account is active.

rejected.title: Access request not approved
rejected.body: Your access request hasn't been approved. If you think this is a mistake, please contact Julià directly.

admin.homeBody: Here you'll see the client list, their sessions, and business metrics (coming soon).

common.empty: You haven't added anything here yet.

income.title: Your income
income.description: Add your income sources, fixed or variable.

expenses.title: Your expenses
expenses.description: Add your regular expenses by category.

assets.title: Your assets
assets.description: Accounts, investments, properties and other things you own.

liabilities.title: Your liabilities
liabilities.description: Mortgage, loans, credit cards or other debts.

summary.title: Your net worth
summary.description: This is what you own minus what you owe, calculated from what you just entered.
